spans.s: khātaka (Ep. Ind., Vol. IV, p. 253, text line 33, note 4), probably, a canal; same as Bengali khāt.

khattaka (EI 8), Kannaḍa; a pedestal or seat.
 (EI 11; HA), a niche; a term found in Jain inscriptions in the said sense.
Khatiba, same as Arabic Khatīb, preacher (Ep. Ind., Vol. XXXIV, p. 145).
